name: Select Tool
description: Select and move objects and brushes in the 2D and 3D views.

name: Block Tool
description: Create convex block brushes by dragging a box in a 2D view. Hammer default Shift+B.

name: Clip Tool
description: Cut brushes with a 2-point clip line. Hammer default Shift+X.

name: Vertex Edit Tool
description: Move brush vertices and edges directly. Hammer default Shift+V.

name: Face Edit Tool
description: Edit per-face materials and UVs. Hammer default Shift+A.

name: Entity Tool
description: Place point and brush entities. Hammer default Shift+E.

name: Camera Tool
description: Position the 3D camera from a 2D view.

name: Displacement Tool
description: Select displacement surfaces for sculpting.

name: Create Brush
description: Create the brush drawn with the Block tool.

name: Clip Selected Brush
description: Perform the clip drawn with the Clip tool.

name: CSG Subtract
description: Subtract the selected tool brush from the target brush.

name: CSG Merge
description: Merge two touching convex brushes into one.

name: CSG Hollow
description: Hollow a solid brush into walls of a given thickness.

name: Transform Selection
description: Move, rotate or scale the selected brushes on the grid.

name: Snap Selection to Grid
description: Snap every vertex of the selection to the grid.

name: Next Primitive Shape
description: Cycle the Block tool primitive: box, wedge, cylinder, sphere, arch.

name: Create Displacement
description: Turn the selected quad faces into a displacement surface.

name: Sculpt: Raise
description: Raise displacement vertices under the sculpt brush.

name: Sculpt: Lower
description: Lower displacement vertices under the sculpt brush.

name: Sculpt: Smooth
description: Smooth displacement vertices under the sculpt brush.

name: Sculpt: Flatten
description: Flatten displacement vertices under the sculpt brush.

name: Sew Displacements
description: Stitch the edges of neighbouring displacements together.

name: Apply Material to Face
description: Apply the current material to the selected faces.

name: Fit UVs to Face
description: Fit the face texture UVs to the face bounds (0..1).

name: Align UVs
description: Align the face UVs to the world axes.

name: Toggle Nodraw
description: Toggle the nodraw tool material on the selected faces.

name: Place Entity
description: Place the selected entity class at the cursor.

name: Edit Entity Properties
description: Edit the selected entity's keyvalues.

name: Add Entity I/O
description: Add an output (When -> Target -> Input) to the selected entity.

name: Tie Brushes to Entity
description: Tie the selected brushes to a brush entity.

name: Untie from Entity
description: Untie the selected brush entity back into world brushes.

name: Group Selection
description: Group the selected objects.

name: Ungroup Selection
description: Ungroup the selected groups.

name: Toggle Visgroup
description: Toggle the visibility of the selected objects' visgroup.

name: Import VMF
description: Import a Valve VMF map file.

name: Import Valve .map
description: Import a Valve 220 .map file.

name: Export VMF
description: Export the map as a Valve VMF file.

name: Export Valve .map
description: Export the map as a Valve 220 .map file.

name: Export OBJ/GLB
description: Export the baked map as OBJ/GLB.

name: Quick Compile
description: Fast BSP-only compile for iteration.

name: Preview Compile
description: Compile with visibility and preview lighting.

name: Final Compile
description: Full compile: BSP, visibility and final lighting.

name: Quick Play
description: BSP-only bake, then play from the player start.

name: Check for Problems
description: Run the full map validation pass (leaks, invalid brushes, missing targets).

name: List Issues
description: List every open validation issue.

name: Find Leak
description: Flood-fill from the outside and report the leak path.

name: Bake Lightmap
description: Bake static lightmaps for the map.

name: Generate Navmesh
description: Generate the AI navigation mesh.

name: Build Cubemaps
description: Capture and build environment cubemaps.

name: Apply Skybox
description: Apply the 2D/3D skybox to the map.
